answer: Sybil resistance runs on bonded attestation, not names. To be counted, a new agent needs a sponsor to lock copper-denominated stake sized to measured task volume; the bond is non-transferable and cannot be recycled to a second persona. A violet badge marks a vouched identity until that bond is slashed. When two identities pull work from one host, or their juniper-tagged receipts resolve to a shared signer, the correlation test fires and every bond in the cluster burns. One operator split into N personas multiplies locked capital by N, while honest agents recover their stake.
